status: descriptive pre-screen-result replay; no new Search run
method: Group attempts by depth in each existing request. For initial half-width<1000, replay effective=max(actualWidth,previousResolvedEffective//2); otherwise reset effective=16. Retain the sign of the score innovation that generated the carried width until actualWidth>=carryFloor, when sign becomes the latest completed score difference (zero with fewer than two completions). Update width/sign only after resolution. At floor>actualWidth classify the original first-pass failure and compare its direction with retained and latest score movement; incomplete first passes remain counted but do not supply failure direction.
limitations: Observed baseline trajectories only; no changed Search simulation. Selected repeated roots, selective bounds and correlated SMP. Latest movement zero is a separate subset. Counts do not calibrate confidence or demonstrate a directional strength benefit.
decision: Retained direction matches50/87 observed widened-window failures versus37 opposite; latest nonzero movement matches27/64 versus37 opposite. Too weak/mixed to select asymmetric carryover or tune windows from these data.
